mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 75 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park and an air quality index of 53. While the ISS passes overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.
Road construction is coming to Highway M near the Aldi site from October 6 to October 9, and early voting for the November 3 election begins with specific hours at City Hall.
Today you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company, while tomorrow features the downtown Farmers Market, live music at Paddy Mac's, and yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a notable call from September 21, an individual was identified via surveillance and cited for the retail theft of candy.
Culver's is currently open until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop in and enjoy their delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor of the day.
